name: macroflow
description: Natural language Excel automation via COM

scripts.dev: set NODE_ENV=development&& concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron-forge start"
scripts.test:search-data: node --experimental-default-type=module --test src/lib/search-data.test.js src/lib/shortcut-audit.test.js src/lib/shortcut-keybind.test.js src/features/search/search-selectors.test.js src/features/search/explorer-selectors.test.js src/features/search/useSearchData.test.js src/features/search/useWorkbookPickerData.test.js src/features/search/usePersonalMacros.test.js src/features/search/explorer-selection.test.js src/features/search/module-actions.test.js src/features/shortcuts/useWorkbookShortcutState.test.js src/features/build/build-target.test.js src/features/workbooks/useWorkbookScopedData.test.js && npm run test:electron
scripts.test:electron: node --test electron/excel-bridge.com-lifetime.test.cjs electron/ipc-handlers.polling-pause.test.cjs electron/llm-performance.test.cjs electron/llm-context.test.cjs electron/openai-client.test.cjs electron/security-policy.test.cjs electron/audit-log.test.cjs electron/window-focus-helper-client.test.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build:window-helper && npm run build && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run build:window-helper && npm run build && electron-forge make
scripts.publish: npm run build:window-helper && npm run build && electron-forge publish
scripts.build:window-helper: dotnet publish native\window-focus-helper\WindowFocusHelper.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true /p:PublishSingleFile=true /p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o native\window-focus-helper\bin-helper
